iOS App Tester Needed (US Only) for Apple App Review Screen Recording
Posted yesterday

Worldwide

14 required Connects (114 available)
Summary

We are looking for an experienced iOS app tester to test our app via TestFlight on a physical iPhone running a recent version of iOS and prepare a clear screen recording for Apple App Review.

The tester must be located in the United States and use a genuine U.S. residential IP address. VPNs, proxies, or other location-masking services are not allowed.

Prior experience testing apps through TestFlight is required.

The recording should:
- Start with launching the app
- Show the complete typical user flow
- Demonstrate registration and login
- Demonstrate account deletion
- Show all major app features
- Show any permission requests or system prompts that appear during normal use

You should also provide:
- Your iPhone model
- The iOS version currently installed
- A short confirmation that the app was tested successfully
- Notes about any bugs, crashes, or other issues found during testing

Please include your iPhone model, current iOS version, and a brief description of your previous experience testing apps through TestFlight when applying.
